tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Please refer tender ocument for all the terms and conditions

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a manufacturer or an authorized dealer of PATOL/Protectowire-Firesystems/Kidde-Fenwal and shall have successfully supplied LHS cable of make PATOL/ProtectowireFiresystems Kidde Fenwalduring the last five(5) financial years (2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23, 2021-22, and 2020-21) to Thermal Power Plants (210 MW and above),Coal Handling Plants (CHP), Government Departmentsor Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). The bidder shall upload copies of Purchase Orders as documentary evidence for orders of valueRs.24.85 Lakhs or above (either a single purchase order or multiple purchase orders not exceeding two)in any two of the preceding five years from the date of notification.

The bidder shall have achieved in his name/firm an average annual turnover of Rs. 49.70 lakhs in at least two financial years in previous five years i.e., 2025-26, 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23, 2021-22. As a proof of this the bidder shall furnish Annual Turnover Certificate / Profit & Loss statement duly certified by a chartered accountant.
